items.title: Zorvantic Reaffirms Token Listing Reviews and Territorial Market Controls
items.summary: Denver, Colorado, Nov. 25, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Global digital asset trading platform Zorvantic Exchange Inc. (hereinafter referred to as “Zorvantic”) today issued an official statement regarding recent public attention surrounding VLVI token trading and regulatory developments in certain European regions, reaffirming the platform’s strict standards for asset listing reviews, global compliance operations, and territorial risk segregation.
